Chapter 924: Chapter 21 Immortal Realm Consciousness (Please Subscribe)_2

Different worlds have different rules, let alone the Main Universe and the Immortal Realm which do not exist in the same dimension.

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path never accepted the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, resulting in his spending hundreds of billions of years to stabilize in the Path Splitting Realm after stepping into the Twelfth Layer.

“Indeed, the assault on the ancestral realm is perilously dangerous; I nearly perished myself back in the day,” the Ancestor of the Immortal Path slightly nodded.

No matter which world or dimension one is in, breaking through to the Twelfth Layer requires liberation from the shackles of the river of time. This necessitates confronting the time river and naturally enduring the backlash from it.

“But with your foundation as the Ancestor of Martial Arts, there shouldn’t be any problems, right?” the Ancestor of the Immortal Path shook his head and said.

Although the Ancestor of the Immortal Path faced backlash from the river of time like a lone boat in a vast ocean when he attempted to break through to the ancestral realm,

the Ancestor of the Immortal Path was also aware that such circumstances test one’s mastery over space-time.

The greater the mastery over space-time, the longer one can prolong the breakthrough attempt, affording more time and opportunities to make that step.

And in terms of mastery over space-time, even the Ancestor of the Immortal Path himself did not compare to Lin Yuan.

This is why the Ancestor of the Immortal Path believed Lin Yuan would have no problems taking that step.

…

“Come, let me introduce you to the Origin Source land,” said the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path led Lin Yuan into the Origin of the Immortal Realm.

This was a boundless space, with vast amounts of the purest Origin Power rippling and gathering into stones—what the outside world called ‘Xianyuan’ stones, priceless and unmarketable.

Lin Yuan now realized the difference between the environment recreated by the Xianyuan stones and the true environment of the Origin of the Immortal Realm.

Over the past few hundred years, Lin Yuan had obtained a great deal of Xianyuan stones through trade, but just now, merely approaching the Origin of the Immortal Realm, the impact of the various rule fluctuations on him far surpassed that of the ‘environment’ replicated by the Xianyuan stones.

“It’s magnificent,” he said.

Gazing upon the Primordial Lands everywhere, Lin Yuan saw various rules manifesting in reality.

These rules were not only manifesting, but also interweaving constantly, which was tremendously helpful to any powerhouse perceiving the rules.

Rules are not static; they are alive. Perceiving just one rule is certainly not as good as perceiving multiple rules at the same time.

The collision between different rules during their perception leads to a greater improvement than what a single rule can provide.

For a time,

Lin Yuan’s mind once again fell into abundant insights. However, having previously adapted to the epiphanies outside the Origin Source land, he did not immediately enter into an enlightened state.

“The Origin Source land is vast and expansive, and over there is where I reside with my Disciple,” said the Ancestor of the Immortal Path as he slightly raised his hand, pointing in one direction.

Following the direction of his hand, Lin Yuan saw a continent quietly suspended there, which was clearly constructed by the Ancestor of the Immortal Path; otherwise, there wouldn’t be such a conspicuous ‘creation’ within the Origin Source land.

“You, as the Ancestor of Martial Arts, can freely choose a place within the Origin Source land to practice and gain insights, or you can create a continent like I did, bringing your Disciples along to perceive together,” said the Ancestor of the Immortal Path with a slight smile.

“Understood,” Lin Yuan nodded.

“Also, within the Origin Source land, you can go to most places, but there is one location you must be cautious about, as it is where the consciousness of the Immortal Realm resides,” said the Ancestor of the Immortal Path while looking at Lin Yuan and waving his hand, manifesting a vast map, which was a map of the Origin Source land.

Nearly ninety-nine percent of the areas on the map were empty, with only the central spot marked in red.

“The consciousness of the Immortal Realm?” Lin Yuan thoughtfully murmured.

Lin Yuan was already aware that worlds have consciousness.

Even the vastly larger Main Universe has its own consciousness.

However, the consciousness of a world is unlike that of a human; it possesses only instincts, devoid of specific emotions.

Normally, the consciousness of the world does not manifest and merely maintains the operation of the world in silence.

But if something occurs that damages the world, its consciousness will intervene.

For instance, in the Main Universe, if those ultimate beings of the Twelfth Layer dare to leave the Main Universe, they will face the rebuke of the entire cosmos.

The source of this rebuke, naturally, is the consciousness of the Main Universe.

The Twelfth Layer ultimates have absorbed massive amounts of energy from the Main Universe; leaving would be akin to severing a large chunk of flesh from it, which is utterly intolerable for the Main Universe.

Therefore, the moment for the Twelfth Layer ultimates to leave the Main Universe comes only when the universe collapses into destruction, and its consciousness also falls into slumber.

“The consciousness of the Immortal Realm is very wary of us. If we get too close, it is very likely to attract the suppression of the entire power of the Immortal Realm.”

The Ancestor of the Immortal Path said with a sense of helplessness.

As a being of the Twelfth Layer, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path was already equivalent to the Immortal Realm.

However, being equivalent does not mean being able to contend. Faced with the power of the entire Immortal Realm, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path still found it difficult to oppose.

Of course, it’s not realistic for the consciousness of the Immortal Realm to suppress a Twelfth Layer consciousness for a long time. It would require a vast amount of energy, and it might even lead to the premature end of the Immortal epoch’s collapse.

Therefore, the Ancestor of the Immortal Path and the consciousness of the Immortal Realm have implicitly reached a balance.

I won’t provoke you, and you won’t provoke me.

“I understand.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Compared to the Ancestor of the Immortal Path, Lin Yuan had a deeper understanding of world consciousness.

“Then I will go back first.”

“Should you have any more questions, my friend, you can contact me at any time.”

After the Ancestor of the Immortal Path finished speaking, his form disappeared, and Lin Yuan clearly felt that the aura of the Ancestor of the Immortal Path appeared on that continent that was created.

“I should also begin my enlightenment.”

Lin Yuan no longer paid attention to the Ancestor of the Immortal Path and immediately dedicated all his focus to the Primordial Lands where the essence of Dao rules were manifesting everywhere.

[Your natural aptitude is incredible, watching the manifestation of many rule essences, your understanding of myriad rules has improved…]

…

In the blink of an eye, two hundred years passed.

Lin Yuan leisurely floated around in various parts of the Primordial Lands.

In two hundred years, Lin Yuan had comprehended tens of thousands of pillar-level fusion rules.

The faintly forming ‘egg’ within his inner world became increasingly distinct, emanating various rule auras and imbuing Lin Yuan’s inner world with the flavor of the Primordial Lands.

“I can feel it, where the consciousness of the Immortal Realm resides, the fluctuations of rules there are more pronounced, no, that’s not just fluctuations anymore; that is the rules themselves.”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes and looked towards the central location of the Primordial Lands.

Actually, arriving at this conclusion was not difficult. Why did the Ancestor of the Immortal Path know that approaching the consciousness of the Immortal Realm would risk suppression?

It’s because the Ancestor of the Immortal Path too had discovered that where the consciousness of the Immortal Realm lay dormant was the source of all rules in the Immortal Realm.

The so-called rule manifestation fluctuations in the Primordial Lands all originate from there.

If one could enter that place to comprehend the rules, it would be far more beneficial than staying in the rest of the Primordial Lands.

“Although I have found the direction to comprehend the Chaos Rule, to actually nurture the Chaos Rule, there is still a long way to go. If I could face the essence of all rules of the Immortal Realm directly…”

Lin Yuan pondered for a moment and decided to attempt to approach the location where the consciousness of the Immortal Realm resided.

Since the Ancestor of the Immortal Path had previously approached and even touched it and was still okay, there’s no reason to think there would be any problems for Lin Yuan.

In terms of life-saving abilities, Lin Yuan was even above the Ancestor of the Immortal Path.

And now, the one at the Primordial Lands was just a manifestation of Lin Yuan. Even if he was really suppressed by the consciousness of the Immortal Realm, it wouldn’t matter much. At worst, he would send another manifestation in.

Before long.

Lin Yuan approached the vicinity of the consciousness of the Immortal Realm.

Hum!!!

Just being in the vicinity, a terrifying consciousness pressure emanated, causing the entire Primordial Lands to tremble.

“Such a huge reaction?”

Lin Yuan was slightly surprised, but he quickly understood.

The location of the Immortal Realm consciousness in the Primordial Lands is equivalent to Lin Yuan’s Spirit World.

It is the most fundamental existence. When an external force approaches, especially a powerful external force, it will definitely trigger the highest alert from the consciousness of the Immortal Realm.

Boom!

Ignoring the warnings from the consciousness of the Immortal Realm, Lin Yuan continued to approach.

Soon, the consciousness of the Immortal Realm mobilized the entire power of the Primordial Lands, rolling towards Lin Yuan to crush him.
